Seule mention: appel du 2026-05-05 (T2 FY26), 'Double-digit year-over-year growth in orders, sales, and earnings' (seuil qualitatif, sans valeur ni perimetre organique). Decision manquante: savoir si un seuil qualitatif 'double digit' suffit a alimenter le KPI; sinon non_publie.

Publie: ER T3 FY25 (0001024478-25-000081, 3e trim. 2025): 'Total company Book-to-bill was ~1.0' avec definition orders/sales; appel 2026-05-05 (T2 FY26): Lifecycle Services 1.07, societe 'slightly above' le corridor normal 0.95-1.10; appel 2026-08-04 (T3 FY26): Lifecycle Services 0.97, ratio societe 'in good shape' sans valeur; appel 2025-11-06 (T4 FY25): book-to-bill autour de 1.
